info.name: Sevi — Site Corpus Sync
info.description:
Trigger and verify the site-RAG corpus sync for the SeviAI API, plus inspect the WordPress mirror it pulls from.

## Setup
Set these collection variables (Collections ▸ this collection ▸ Variables):
- `base_url` — the SeviAI API base.
  - Host-run API directly:     http://localhost:8000
  - Via the compose web proxy: http://localhost:8090/api   (main stack)
  - sevi-local stack:          http://localhost:8091/api
  - Public tunnel:             https://<your-domain>/api
- `corpus_url` — the internal WordPress mirror (must be LAN-reachable from wherever you run Postman AND from the API host). Default: http://192.168.10.130:9090
- `admin_pin` — your DASHBOARD_PIN (leave blank here; set it as a secret and never commit it).

## Important
The sync runs SERVER-SIDE: the API host itself must be able to reach `corpus_url`. Postman only triggers it. The endpoint takes no body — it reads SITE_CORPUS_URL from the API's env.

## Order to run
1. Health — confirm the API is up.
2. Sync Site Corpus — pulls pages+posts, rewrites docs/site_corpus.txt, reindexes. Returns {docs, skipped, path, index_available}.
3. Admin Status — confirm site_rag is ready / doc count.

The two 'Source (mirror)' requests are optional — they hit the WordPress REST API directly so you can see exactly what content the sync will ingest.

request.description: Sanity check the API is up and the classifier is loaded before syncing.

exec: console.log('docs=' + b.docs + ' skipped=' + b.skipped + ' index_available=' + b.index_available);

request.description:
Re-pull the official website into docs/site_corpus.txt and rebuild the TF-IDF index. No body — the server reads SITE_CORPUS_URL from its env. Gated by X-Admin-Pin.

Errors:
- 403 -> admin_pin doesn't match the API's DASHBOARD_PIN.
- 502 'Site corpus sync failed: ...' -> the API host cannot reach SITE_CORPUS_URL (portal down / not on the LAN / unset).
Single-pane subsystem status. Check the brain.site_rag block to confirm the corpus is loaded after a sync.

Exactly what _fetch_collection(base_url, 'pages') pulls. Inspect this to see the source pages the sync ingests. Increment `page` to walk further. Requires LAN access to corpus_url from your Postman machine.
Exactly what _fetch_collection(base_url, 'posts') pulls (news/announcements). Requires LAN access to corpus_url.
